title: ChroPlate - ProteinA/G
author: David Frommholz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8qrhvv6

steps.title: Load sample (centrifuge)
steps.instruction: Place the ChroPlate on a clean deep‑well plate, add up to 1.5 ml sample per well, adjust the sample to pH 7.5‑8.5 and 150‑300 mM NaCl (add 1/11 volume of 0.5 M Tris, 2 M NaCl, pH 8.0 if needed), then centrifuge 2‑10 min at 400 g in a swing‑out rotor (use >5 min for volumes >1 ml or viscous samples). Keep flow‑through and wash fractions for later analysis.

steps.title: Wash plate (centrifuge)
steps.instruction: Empty the deep‑well plate (or place the ChroPlate on a clean one), add 500 µl wash buffer to each well (optionally up to 1 % Tween‑20 and/or up to 0.5 M NaCl for reducing nonspecific interactions), place a dummy filter plate underneath for counter‑balance, and centrifuge 2 min at 400 g. Repeat this wash two additional times for increased purity.

steps.title: Elute bound protein (centrifuge)
steps.instruction: Place the ChroPlate on a clean deep‑well plate, add 300 µl elution buffer to each well, centrifuge 2 min at 400 g, and repeat the elution two more times (total three elutions).

steps.title: Neutralize eluate
steps.instruction: Add one drop of neutralization solution to every well of the deep‑well plate and mix gently.

steps.title: Load sample (vacuum)
steps.instruction: Place the ChroPlate on a clean deep‑well plate, add up to 1.5 ml sample per well, adjust to pH 7.5‑8.5 and 150‑300 mM NaCl (add 1/11 volume of 0.5 M Tris, 2 M NaCl, pH 8.0 if needed), then apply a vacuum of 100 mbar for 2‑3 min (longer for volumes >1 ml or viscous samples). Keep flow‑through for later analysis.

steps.title: Wash plate (vacuum)
steps.instruction: Assemble the vacuum device per the manufacturer’s instructions, empty the deep‑well plate (or place the ChroPlate on a clean one), add 500 µl wash buffer to each well (optionally up to 1 % Tween‑20 and/or up to 0.5 M NaCl, noting that Tween may cause frothing), place the ChroPlate on a waste receptacle, and apply a vacuum of 100 mbar for 2 min. Repeat the wash two additional times for increased purity.

steps.title: Elute bound protein (vacuum)
steps.instruction: Place the ChroPlate on a clean deep‑well plate, add 100 µl elution buffer to each well, apply a vacuum of 100 mbar for 2 min, and repeat the elution two more times (total three elutions).

steps.title: Neutralize eluate (vacuum)
steps.instruction: Add one drop of neutralization solution to every well of the deep‑well plate and mix gently.
